jellyfin.title: Jellyfin Sync Mode
jellyfin.description: Sync all artwork from Plex to Jellyfin
jellyfin.syncInfo: This mode will synchronize every artwork you have in Plex to your Jellyfin server.
jellyfin.step1Text: The script requires that library names in Plex and Jellyfin match exactly for the sync to work.
jellyfin.step2Text: The script calculates the hash of artwork from both servers to determine if there are differences.
jellyfin.step3Text: Only syncs artwork if the hashes don't match, saving time and bandwidth.
jellyfin.tip: Tip: This is handy if you want to run the sync after a Kometa run, so you have Kometa overlayed images in Jellyfin.
jellyfin.important: Important: Ensure 'UsePlex' is set to true and your Jellyfin API details are fully validated.

emby.title: Emby Sync Mode

emby.step3Text: Only syncs artwork if the hashes don't match, saving time and bandwidth.
emby.tip: Tip: This is handy if you want to run the sync after a Kometa run, so you have Kometa overlayed images in Emby.
emby.important: Important: Ensure 'UsePlex' is set to true and your Emby API details are fully validated.

backup.step2Text: This is handy for creating a second asset folder with Kometa/TCM EXIF data, which can then be used by Jellyfin or Emby.

requirements.title: Requirements
requirements.description: Sonarr and Posterizarr must both be running as Docker containers

howItWorks: Sonarr creates a .posterizarr file in the watcher directory when a file is imported
The file contains metadata about the imported episode
Posterizarr monitors this directory for new files
When detected, Posterizarr waits up to 5 minutes (based on file age)
Then reads the file and triggers a poster creation run for that specific item

clearlogo.title: Logo (Clearlogo)
clearlogo.description: Replaces standard text with the movie/show clearlogo.

clearart.title: Logo (Clearart)
clearart.description: Replaces standard text with the movie/show clearart.

flatClearlogo.title: Flat White Logo (Clearlogo)
flatClearlogo.description: Replaces standard text with a clearlogo converted to a flat white color for better contrast.

flatClearart.title: Flat White Logo (Clearart)
flatClearart.description: Replaces standard text with a clearart converted to a flat white color for better contrast.

showTitleSeason.title: Show Title on Season
showTitleSeason.description: Adds the show title (or logo if logo settings are enabled) to season posters alongside the season text.

minimalist.title: Minimalist Posters
minimalist.description: Disables image processing entirely. Only the raw poster gets downloaded and moved to the asset directory.

fullOverlays.title: Enable All Overlays
fullOverlays.description: Enables borders, text, and overlays across all standard posters, season posters, backgrounds, and title cards.

resolutionOverlays.title: Resolution Overlays
resolutionOverlays.description: Enables resolution and HDR/DoVi overlays based on media metadata. Note: Not all resolution overlay files are provided by default (e.g. you will need to supply poster-4k, background-1080p, etc.).

onlyBorders.title: Only Borders
onlyBorders.description: Disables text and overlays, rendering only borders across all posters and cards.

onlyText.title: Only Text
onlyText.description: Disables borders and overlays, rendering only text (or logos) across all posters and cards.

onlyOverlays.title: Only Overlays
onlyOverlays.description: Disables text and borders, rendering only resolution/rating overlays across all posters and cards.

textless.title: Textless Posters Only
textless.description: Configures language orders to 'xx' to ensure only textless artwork is downloaded. Skips artwork with text.

builder.tabBuilderDesc: Create your own custom blueprint by mixing and matching specific overlays.
